findings.summary: Post-capture port and artifact accessors lack retained identity validation.
findings.location: trust.py CapturedLifecyclePort.artifact/audit and CapturedJsonArtifact.value/audit, around line 512
findings.counterexample: After bindings.require() consumes a valid stream, a single handle poke replaces port._artifact or artifact._value. Accessors return forged data.
findings.consequence: Unverified data delivery violates ADR-0123 final immutable captured value and ADR-0126 public opaque-handle/single-poke rule. Publication/freeze validators cannot catch this post-capture path.
findings.disposition: Open; successor full-handle convergence checkpoint requested before another matrix correction.

reviewer_conclusion: The retained publication/stream-pin design otherwise closes the post-PUBLISHED descriptor and frozen-identity family stated in 0114.
reviewer_limits: Read-only design review; no new RED, full focused suite, real execution, or environment changes.
next_gate: Independent full-handle convergence checkpoint, family-wide matrix correction, fresh clean Terra Phase 0 before RED.

convergence_checkpoint.status: changed approach authorized; no owner decision needed
convergence_checkpoint.retained_reviewer_output:
Independent successor convergence checkpoint: RR004 requires a family-wide handle correction.
Changed approach authorized within existing broker/view/intern ownership:
1. Retain authenticated immutable records for the whole graph: publication -> frozen port -> verified capture -> member path/handle -> bindings input -> lifecycle port -> artifact payload/audit.
2. Make every accessor validate that record under the existing lifecycle lock: VerifiedCapture.member, member read_bytes/read_text, CapturedBindings.require, lifecycle-port artifact/audit, artifact value/audit.
3. Bind each member handle to its exact verified parent, broker, stream, path, retained bytes, and unread state. A foreign member inserted into a valid parent must refuse; resetting _read must not enable a second read.
4. Bind lifecycle-port/artifact accessors to the exact consumed input and retained verified payload/audit. Return the retained record values, never mutable handle slots.
5. Sweep single pokes of parent maps, member/port/artifact fields, _used, and _read; assert no forged value, cross-broker association, second read/consume, provider access, or additional receipt/session effects.
_LIFECYCLE_VIEWS alone authenticates a view's broker/stream; it does not bind a returned member to its parent, and lifecycle-port/artifact currently have no corresponding retained association. This correction covers publication, frozen, member, port, and artifact identity together, avoiding another isolated patch.
Limits retained: Packet 8 durable restart/spend; development-key signature forgery; combined intern mint plus handle poke; multi-internal rewrites; P7 replay grammar. No owner decision needed.
